Slides and video recording of the talk "3MS Framework" by Fabrice Tereszkiewicz from Astrom / Zimmer & Tereszkiewicz, held at the Museum für Kommunikation in Bern on October 15th, 2025. Over a series of diagrams, the talk builds a complete data infrastructure layer by layer. A pipeline brings external data and vocabularies into a SPARQL endpoint, following FAIR and Linked Open Data principles, and raises the question of how to get from LOD to Linked Open Usable Data (LOUD). The triple management system 3MS is then added: it sits on top of the triple store, works as a data index and serves the data through a REST API to list views and detail views on the web. Further layers add a CMS and administration interface, mobile apps, authentication, OAI-PMH harvesting and reporting. The slides contain mostly diagrams and are best read together with the video recording.

## Learning outcomes

After working through this resource, users will be able to:

- describe the main components of an infrastructure for publishing linked data
- explain the role of a triple management system between a SPARQL endpoint and user-facing applications
- discuss how indexing and APIs improve data accessibility beyond raw SPARQL access
- identify supporting services such as authentication, OAI-PMH and reporting
